analysisRules: Never infer branch authority from branch name, commit count, age, or open/closed PR state alone.
Always classify each branch before proposing a merge.
Use compare_commits against main to determine ahead/behind/diverged state.
If a branch is fully contained by main, treat it as historical unless project.status.json explicitly marks it active.
If a branch diverged from main, do not wholesale merge unless this manifest explicitly allows it.
For diverged historical branches, recover individual commits/files only after architecture and ownership review.
Open PR does not imply current work; merged/closed PR history and this manifest take precedence.

main is the only authoritative integration branch unless this manifest is versioned to say otherwise; lastReviewedMainCommit is evidence of the last topology review, not a required equality with live main HEAD.

A branch does not need to correspond 1:1 with a numbered bounded slice. Multiple closely related slices may live in one bundle branch when one business acceptance story and one coherent evidence scenario cover them.
Bundle branches must remain business-bounded: do not mix unrelated capabilities, speculative platform work, broad refactors, or opportunistic cleanup into the same PR.

For an ACTIVE_WORK bundle, inspect project.status.json open/closed gates and the PR evidence to determine which sub-gates are implemented or verified; do not infer all numbered slices are complete merely because they share a branch.
Prefer fewer evidence-complete branches over mechanically tiny branches when auditability, rollback clarity, and failure localization remain intact.
After a bundle is merged, main becomes the only authoritative source of those capabilities; the source branch becomes MERGED_MILESTONE and must not be revived for new work.

requiredLLMProcedure: Read AGENTS.md, LLM.md, context.manifest.json, project.status.json, and branch.topology.json.
List current branches from GitHub rather than assuming this file is complete.
For any unclassified branch, compare it to main and classify it before merge advice.
For branches classified MERGED_MILESTONE or ANCESTOR_MILESTONE, do not merge again.
For DIVERGED_HISTORICAL, inspect only explicitly needed commits/files; never infer that missing files are accidental omissions.
For ACTIVE_WORK branches, verify current PR, CI, work packet, and base before proposing merge.
If GitHub reality conflicts with this file, report BRANCH_TOPOLOGY_DRIFT and update this file before making merge recommendations.

branchStrategy.bundleDefinition: One short-lived branch may contain multiple strongly related bounded slices when they form one coherent business acceptance and database-evidence boundary.
bundleEntryCriteria: same business loop and business outcome
bundleExitCriteria: required sub-gates reach declared evidence level
merge to main before starting the next independent capability
antiPattern: one branch per task number by habit
long-lived integration branch competing with main
mixing unrelated business domains in one bundle
using branch names or PR openness as authority

currentBranchGuidance.afterSuccess: Merge to main, then implement C05 Bundle A on a new branch.
currentBranchGuidance.rule: Do not start WMS/TMS or cross-entity transfer work as part of this packet.
